messages:
Marta (Customer): Hey team — we started seeing the rerank endpoint return almost identical scores for every candidate after we swapped our embed model to `embed-lite-2`. Not just noisy, literally the same top-5 scores each query. Impacting production search ranking. Anyone seen this?

Emma (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, Marta. Can you paste a sample request and the exact models you're mixing (embedding model + rerank model)? Also any recent config toggles (auto-projection, compatibility flags)?

Marta (Customer): Sure. We generate embeddings with `embed-lite-2` (1536 dims) and call the rerank endpoint using `rerank-small-v2` (expected 1024 dims). We didn't change rerank model. Here's a sanitized curl we used: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\n    "model": "rerank-small-v2",\n    "query_vector": [0.01, -0.2, ... /* 1536 values */],\n    "candidate_vectors": [[...], [...], ...]\n  }'\n```

We expected a 400 for dim mismatch but got back scores like `0.237, 0.237, 0.237, 0.237` across candidates.

Tomas (ML Eng): Interesting — in our test harness a strict dim check raises 400. We do have a runtime flag `auto_project_vectors` that was turned on in a staging rollout last week. If the gateway auto-projects, it might be projecting 1536->1024 with a lossy transform. But uniform identical scores smell like a projection bug (e.g., zeroing or a NaN->clamp path).

DeployBot: [log] 2026-03-15T14:12:05Z WARN gateway: vector length 1536 != 1024 expected by rerank-small-v2 -> auto_project enabled, applying projection matrix proj_v2

Eli (SRE): Can you share the raw response (headers + body)? Need to see if scores are actually identical floats or if rounding/clamping at client side is causing it. Also confirm rates — is any timeout/partial response happening?

Marta (Customer): Raw body: `{ "scores": [0.2374, 0.2374, 0.2374, 0.2374], "model": "rerank-small-v2" }` Headers show 200 OK. No timeouts.

Tomas (ML Eng): That body is consistent with a bug server-side. Repro path suggestion: 1) generate synthetic vector of length 1536 with small random values; 2) call rerank-small-v2 with gateway `auto_project` on; 3) check projection matrix application; 4) compute dot products locally to compare. I'll add a minimal py repro.

```python
# repro.py (pseudo)
import requests, numpy as np
q = np.random.normal(size=(1536,)).astype(float)
cands = [np.random.normal(size=(1536,)).tolist() for _ in range(4)]
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', json={
  'model': 'rerank-small-v2',
  'query_vector': q.tolist(),
  'candidate_vectors': cands
}, headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer $TOKEN'})
print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
```

Tomas (ML Eng): Locally, if I simulate a projection by multiplying by a random 1024x1536 matrix I get varied scores. If the projection matrix is zeroed (or a bug returns the same projected vector for all cands), you'd see identical scores.

Eli (SRE): Quick mitigation for customers: disable `auto_project_vectors` at the gateway config or enforce a strict dim check that returns 400. I'll prepare a rollout to flip the flag for affected infra to false.

Lydia (Product): We should proactively notify any customers using mismatched model combinations. Also discuss whether auto-projection should be opt-in. Marta — are you okay with me opening an incident notice and offering a credit while we investigate?

Marta (Customer): Yes please, a notice + short credit would be appreciated. Our search impact started around 09:10 UTC today.

Emma (Support): Assigning internally: Tomas -> root cause and repro + test, Eli -> config rollback/guard, Lydia -> customer comms and credit, Emma -> follow-up and confirm mitigation with Marta.

Tomas (ML Eng): Quick findings — when `auto_project` path selects `proj_v2` WE accidentally re-used a shared buffer and didn't reinitialize the projection accumulator. If candidate batch size >1 you end up with the projected query vector reused for every candidate leading to identical dot products. I can reproduce with small script. Patch incoming: zero-init accumulator before multiply.

Tomas (ML Eng): Patch PR #5823 ready, adding unit test that fails prefix. Also added explicit dim-check fallback that returns 400 if projection matrix missing.

Eli (SRE): Rolling hotfix to canary (region eu-west-1) now; will monitor 1% traffic for 15m then 10m windows. If no regression, promote.

DeployBot: [deploy] service/gateway canary -> sha:abc123 -> regions: eu-west-1 -> status: started

Marta (Customer): Confirmed after ~5m that scores are back to varied for a few queries I retried. Looks good so far. Thanks.

Lydia (Product): We'll send an advisory: include recommended practice — don't mix embed models with different dims unless you intentionally enable projection and validate results. We'll also make `auto_project` opt-in until we're comfortable.

Emma (Support): Action items summary for ticket #8762: 1) Tomas -> merge patch + add e2e repro, 2) Eli -> complete rollout and set strict-dim guard at gateway, 3) Lydia -> customer advisory + credit, 4) Emma -> close loop with Marta after 24h.

Marta (Customer): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please ping here when full rollout is done. :heart:

Eli (SRE): Will update when promoted to prod across regions. For now canary green.

Tomas (ML Eng): Merged PR, added regression test to CI. Leaving note in changelog about projection buffer fix.

Emma (Support): Noted. Closing initial escalation after 24h of stable signals. If anything else, re-open.

DeployBot: [deploy] service/gateway prod -> sha:abc123 -> status: success (all regions)

Marta (Customer): Confirmed production is good for us. Closing on our side. Thanks again! :tada:
